patch.value: Explain invalid Beads dependencies with bounded row repair packets

Overlap checked against beads validate, core relationship analytics, pm-graph analytics, and pm-csv provenance. This adds Beads JSONL row addresses and exact external identities plus revalidated edge-removal proposals. It does not replace core topology or CSV cell provenance.

A cycle involving three of 10000 rows returns those rows and edges within declared input, work and output budgets; every emitted candidate revalidates; malformed and unresolved references remain explicit gaps; no title-based identity inference.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap: beads validate already reports invalid JSON, dangling blockers and cycle messages; pm-graph owns workspace analytics; pm-csv owns table provenance. Use core RelationshipGraph and analyzeRelationshipExecution over opaque row tokens to preserve case-sensitive external identities. Add a read-only repair packet, bounded candidate edge removals, explicit gaps and source-byte revision guards. No tracker writes, journals or role-based lifecycle decisions are added.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation: typed read-only packet and preview APIs, canonical CLI plus alias, lazy public graph SDK loading, exact UTF-8 source revision guard, isolated row gaps, integer work/input/output ceilings, and bounded fully revalidated edge-removal candidates. Targeted numeric/alias/extreme-value corpora and 512 seeded graph operation sequences compare an independent transitive-closure model, preserve every untouched native field, replay older inputs and verify native state read back through the real SDK. Existing import/export/transfer/reconciliation/outgoing model suites remain in the unchanged CI full gate. Behavioral revert in a disposable non-git copy suppressed only the new cycle witness; the 10000-row regression failed (expected one cycle, got zero). New module measured 100% lines, branches and functions. Follow-up required for previously ignored blocks-only provider rows; repair keeps them explicit gaps.

value.text: Continuation of PR 188 after reading its body and existing evidence. Merged origin/main first. General rule: never serialize an untrusted JSON row through JavaScript numbers; edits preserve unchanged source bytes, including duplicate keys and numeric lexemes. Audit every JSON parser/serializer in repair, sidecar, reconcile, transfer, outgoing and native import/export; exercise SDK, JSON/TOON CLI, packed npm/Bun launchers and non-git trackers. value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Package-wide precision audit: repair editedText was the direct whole-row round trip; sidecar restore was a second row reserializer, and sidecar parse/capture could silently round long decimal literals. Shared syntax-validated JSON source spans now retain untouched row bytes and surviving dependency object tokens, including foreign overflowing exponents. Sidecar restore retains existing field text; its version 1 numeric envelope refuses nonrepresentable new literals before output, while accepting equivalent decimal spellings and previously emitted canonical envelopes. Reconcile, transfer and outgoing reserialize documented schema projections of native fields, strings, revisions and integer counts rather than preserved opaque source rows; native export serializes SDK-owned mapped rows. JSON and TOON repair receipts contain only bounded witness coordinates and exact string identities. New 512-sequence source-byte oracle passed, including beyond-2^53 integers, negative zero, overflowing/underflowing exponents, long decimals, duplicate foreign and dependency keys, CRLF, escapes and surviving edge metadata. Added the two-worker ceiling to the coverage runner without changing thresholds.
